card.name: Words just before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, of, than, at) and the first piece of a drug name, right before a named drug such as clopidogrel, atorvastatin, warfarin or lemborexant. Seen in comparison and co-administration sentences.

modes.label: Linking word before comparator
modes.description: A word like with, than or of that precedes a comparison drug.

modes.label: Start of split drug name
modes.description: The opening piece of a drug name such as atorvastatin or lemborexant, split into parts.
modes.example: dabigatran did not meaningfully alter the pharmacokinetics of amiodarone,<< at>>orvastatin, clarithrom
